instrument_type: spot gold / USD; NOT Bybit XAUUSDT perpetual
resolution: Every original tick; UTC millisecond timestamps; no resampling or deduplication
caveats: Legacy HTTP files use millisecond offsets from the start of the HOUR, not the daily S3 convention.
Source URL months are zero-based; exported dates use normal UTC dates.
Empty and missing hours are audited. No quotes are invented.
HTTP 404 is recorded as not_found, not assumed to prove a market closure.
Completed traversal means every hour was checked, not that the provider guarantees no lost ticks.
Volume fields retain source float32 values and units; they are not Bybit order-book sizes.
Prices are source integers / 1000, exactly three decimal places.
Ordering, duplicate timestamps, and timestamp regressions are preserved.
